devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Virtual switches created by this platform. Each device gets its own virtual switch, schedule entries, inverse-state behavior, manual override behavior, and optional periodic schedule check.

id.title: Stable ID
id.description: Optional stable identifier for this virtual switch. When omitted, the plugin generates it from the name and writes it to Homebridge config.json. Keep it unchanged when renaming or changing settings.

name.title: Name
name.description: The display name shown for this virtual switch. Automations can use this switch turning on or off as their trigger.

inverseState.title: Inverse State
inverseState.description: When disabled, the switch is on inside configured ranges and off outside them. When enabled, the switch is off inside configured ranges and on outside them.

entries.title: Schedule Entries
entries.description: Schedule ranges for this virtual switch. By default each range represents on state. Enable inverse state to make each range represent off state instead.

days.title: Days
days.description: Days where this entry starts. Leave empty or omit the field to use every day.

start.title: Start Time
start.description: Local 24-hour time where this entry starts, formatted as HH:mm.

end.title: End Time
end.description: Local 24-hour time where this entry ends, formatted as HH:mm. An end time earlier than the start time creates an overnight range.

enableIntervalCheck.title: Enable Periodic Check
enableIntervalCheck.description: When enabled, this device periodically re-applies the schedule even between start and end triggers. When disabled, manual changes remain until the next configured schedule trigger.

intervalMinutes.title: Interval Minutes
intervalMinutes.description: Periodic check interval in minutes, aligned from local 00:00. For example, 15 checks at :00, :15, :30, and :45. Used only when periodic checks are enabled.
